raw_segments.text: These floors are like the pleasures of the world—this bloody man, the care aunt.
I hope I dream, for so I thought I was a cavekeeper and cook to honest creatures.
But tis not so.
Twas but a bolt of nothing, shot at nothing, which the brain makes of fumes.
Our very eyes are sometimes, like our judgments, blind.
Good faith I tremble still with fear, but if there be yet left in heaven a small a drop
of pity as a wren's eye feared gods, a part of it—the dreams here still.
Even when I wake it is without me as within me, not imagined, felt.
A headless man, the garments of posthumous.
I know the shape of his leg—this is his hand, his foot mercurial, his martial thigh,
the bronze of Hercules—but his jovial face, murder in heaven.
How?
Tea's gone.
Pisanio, all curses matted Hecuba gave the Greeks, and mine to boot be darted on thee.
Thou, conspired with that irregulars devil, Cloten, hath here cut off my lord.
To write and read be henceforth treacherous.
Damned Pisanio hath with his forged letters,
damned Pisanio from this most bravest vessel of the world struck the main top.
O posthumous, alas, where is thy head?
Where's that?
I mean, where's that?
Pisanio might have killed thee at the heart and left this head on.
How should this be?
Pisanio, tea's he and Cloten, malice and lucre in them have laid this woe here.
O tea's pregnant, pregnant.
The drug he gave me, which he said was precious and cordial to me,
have I not found it murderous to T.H. senses?
That confirms at home.
This is Pisanio's deed and Cloten.
O, give color to my pale cheek with thy blood
that we the horridder may seem to those which chance to find us.
O my lord, my lord.
